additional_benchmark_policy: Admit one nontrivial sequential benchmark only after source rights, ATPG, and scan-FF identity are qualified; never substitute silently.

architecture_selection.B1: observed execute_dft_plan chain only, unavailable otherwise
architecture_selection.Rstar: minimum H8 among the five predeclared Phase-0 random orders; ties by architecture SHA256

meaningful_conflict_rule.denominator: physical-optimum architecture in each design and physical seed
meaningful_conflict_rule.notes: A distinct H8 optimum must improve H8 by at least 5% and cost at least 10% more physical length. Both directions must repeat in at least four of five independent placements per design. This is a deliberately conservative engineering threshold, not a statistical significance test.

analysis_stage: compare structured metrics from the same ORFS global-route and detailed-route stages
run_id_rule: sha256(canonical JSON of campaign, design, physical_seed, method, architecture_sha256, OpenROAD version, ORFS commit); first 20 hexadecimal digits
learning_gate: No ML until G5, G6, G7a, G7b, G8 pass
